name: Sizzlipede
description: Sizzlipede, the Radiator Pokémon. Able to evolve into Centiskorch. A Fire and Bug type.
pokedex_entries: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.
It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils. Once they're well-done, it will voraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.
